title: Finalize a change in seconds on Raven however many archives it holds
description: Finalize a change in seconds on Raven however many archives it holds
acceptance_criteria: SpecSync archive (finalize) no longer takes minutes on Raven: the Git processes one finalize spawns grow by a small bounded number per other archived change instead of re-walking every archive's history, and every verdict and refusal is identical to a live run.

answers.constraints: change.3md: refusing gates stay live and only passing verdicts are reused; REQ-change-119's digest and history rule for the persistent cache; Leif t811u and t813u: never weaken a gate, do not change who approves, native SpecSync state keeps deciding stage gates, do not raise timeouts.
